test_item:
AuthData contains Manifest file, manifest signature and SAM certificate file.
(manifest, signature and certificate files follow the SAM package naming and format)
pre:
1. DUT is connected via ADB with root permission (Dev/Eng build)
2. SAM dongle is inserted into the DUT
proc:
1. Confirm the content of /data/vendor/dauth on the DUT
$ adb shell ls -l /data/vendor/dauth
2. Read the SAM certificate format on the host
$ openssl x509 -in SAMcert.pem -text
er:
1. The adb shell ls -l /data/vendor/dauth output lists the manifest, the signature and the certificate files
2. The openssl x509 output shows the certificate in x509 PEM format
design: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
